title: Sparkly anchor
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='shank' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#8fb8d8'/>
      <stop offset='0.5' stop-color='#d8ecf8'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#6f96b8'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='ring' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffe27a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#e8b030'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- decorative ring at top -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='20' r='11' fill='none' stroke='url(#ring)' stroke-width='6'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='20' r='11' fill='none' stroke='#fff3c0' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- crown / crossbar -->
  <rect x='26' y='29' width='48' height='7' rx='3.5' fill='url(#shank)'/>

  <!-- shank -->
  <rect x='46.5' y='34' width='7' height='42' rx='3.5' fill='url(#shank)'/>
  <rect x='47.5' y='34' width='2' height='42' fill='#eaf6ff'/>

  <!-- arms of the anchor -->
  <path d='M50 74 C40 74 30 80 28 90 C36 88 44 86 50 86 C56 86 64 88 72 90 C70 80 60 74 50 74 Z' fill='#a8cbe4'/>
  <path d='M50 86 C44 86 36 88 28 90 C36 84 44 82 50 81 Z' fill='#d8ecf8'/>

  <!-- flukes (arrow tips) -->
  <path d='M28 90 L21 78 L33 82 Z' fill='#c8e0f0'/>
  <path d='M72 90 L79 78 L67 82 Z' fill='#c8e0f0'/>

  <!-- stock (small crossbar near top) -->
  <rect x='34' y='38' width='32' height='4.5' rx='2.25' fill='#9ec4e0'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#fff6b0' stroke='#ffe27a' stroke-width='1'>

    <path d='M18 60 L19.5 56 L21 60 L25 61.5 L21 63 L19.5 67 L18 63 L14 61.5 Z'/>

</svg>
